title: fix(metadata-protocol): the publish probes skip a missing widget dataset, not check the read's envelope
body:
Fixes #34560

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发布后的运行时探针在读取仪表盘组件引用的数据集时，若数据集不存在，现在按「图问题」跳过，不再把读取结果的外层信封当成数据集去检查。
- 为什么改：按名称读取元数据时，条目不存在会返回一个 item 为空的外层信封，而不是空值；读取函数把信封本身当成了数据集，导致该组件被计入「已检查」，还会报出一条假的「组件查询失败」（已实测复现）。
- 风险与回滚：极低。只改一行读取逻辑：信封里没有 item 就返回空；存在的数据集读取方式不变。回滚即还原该行。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`（`publishedItemReader` 的返回行）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes-dataset-holders.test.ts`（新增的 `[#34560]` 用例组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/build-probes-dataset-holders.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`publishedItemReader` (the item read the ADR-0038 L3 publish probes use, over the protocol facade at `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`) returned `wrapper?.item ?? wrapper`. The real by-name read `getMetaItem` answers an item nothing holds with its envelope (`{ type, name, item: undefined, lock, editable, … }`), never a throw and never `undefined`, so the reader handed the envelope to the widget plane as the dataset body. A widget naming a missing dataset was then counted in `checked.widgets`, and its query ran over the envelope, which reports a false `widget_query_failed`.

The reader now returns the envelope's `item` alone (`envelope?.item`). A dataset that exists is read exactly as before; a missing one reads as no body, so the widget takes the dangling-dataset path again (an L1 graph finding, not probed, not counted).

Why the fallback existed: it was born with the probes (`106ce3d1dc`, ADR-0038 L3) as a defensive spread for a protocol that might answer a bare body. No producer ever did: `getMetaItem` answered an envelope then and answers one now. Every double that feeds `publishedItemReader` was checked, and none returns a bare body:

- `build-probes-dataset-holders.test.ts` (the `#31700` protocol double): answers `{ item }`, `undefined`, or throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`;
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`: drive the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, on datasets that exist or that are refused.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes-dataset-holders.test.ts` gains a top-level `[#34560]` describe that drives `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` itself (its real `getMetaItem` and `resolveCallerPackageAddress`) over a registry double that reads `dataset` by package, as `SchemaRegistry` does. So the envelope under test is the one the read builds, not a hand-copied one. It covers both reader arms, from the publishing package (the publish path) and by name:

- the real read answers `missing_ds` with an envelope whose `item` is undefined, and the reader returns `undefined` for it;
- the widget plane: `checked.widgets` is 1 (only the existing dataset), no issue codes, and only `own_ds` is queried;
- CONTROL: an existing dataset is handed over as its body (no `item` key).

`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains one row: the new engine double's `findOne` is pinned through `assertEngineFindOnePredicate`, and `check:engine-double-contract` asks the ledger to record it (`--write`: 1 row added, 0 lost).

## Tests

Premise, measured on the unmodified `build-probes.ts` (`origin/main` `082f9c2945`) with the new pin: 4 of the new cases fail, with the real envelope and the false finding in the output.

```text
× read by name: the real read answers a missing dataset with its envelope, and the reader hands the probes no body
× read by name: the widget takes the L1 skip path: not counted, not queried, no widget_query_failed
```

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `build-probes.ts`, anchor `return envelope?.item;` replaced with `return envelope?.item ?? envelope ?? undefined;` (the pre-fix fallback). The test imports `./build-probes.js` by relative specifier, so it reads `src/`, not `dist/`.

```text
  Tests  4 failed | 9 passed (13)     (the same four cases as the premise reading)

```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The analytics double in the pin refuses a body that binds no object. That is how the false `widget_query_failed` shows up in the test. Whatever the real analytics service does with an envelope, the reader fix keeps the envelope from reaching it.
- The registry double declares `dataset` read by package (`readsByPackage`), as `SchemaRegistry` does. With `NO_PACKAGE_SCOPED_READS` alone, the real read refuses the bare `dataset` read as unjudgeable (ADR-0150 D2/D3) before it reaches the envelope.

## Verification

Every reading below was taken at head `aaafe49eff` (the branch with `origin/main` merged in; `main` had moved `meta-compile-cache.ts` / `meta-overlay-cache.ts` in this package, which `getMetaItem` reads through, so the package suite was run again after the merge).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: Test Files 348 passed | 9 skipped (357), Tests 23056 passed | 45 skipped (23101); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, derived at `aaafe49eff`): 73 run, each exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `Run reconciliation — 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.` The dist-reading families (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:published-files`) ran after a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`) and a rebuild of this package after the merge.
- Not run locally, declared to CI: `test:repo`, and the importers' suites in `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/runtime` (the reader's exported type is unchanged; its answer changes only for an item nothing holds, which neither suite reads). Dogfood: n/a (no `!` in the title, `Clause-②: no`).
